1004902.description: Thinking of the distant deep forest, where the Shroomlings await her return, the rugged path beneath her feet seems to smooth out, her weariness fading as memories ease the fatigue of the journey.

1005101.description: A young girl crosses the vast ocean, starting a new life alone in a foreign land. She knows that only the items in her suitcase still carry the familiar scent of home. As she gently opens it, her homeland quietly unfurls within her heart.

1005102.description: After a long journey across the seas, she returns to her distant homeland. The echoes of old times softly call to her, but do the memories still match the scenes she left behind?

1005201.description: At the tips of tender buds, the first peach blossoms begin to unfurl. With a friend by her side, she steps deeper into the heart of spring, as the warm breeze sweeps through every alley.

1005202.description: When spring arrives, brew a pot of tea with the morning dew and await the arrival of those who will enjoy the tea with you.

1005601.description: In the endless desert, a sacred land endures for those who ride the waves. To them, the desert is merely another ocean waiting to be conquered.

1005602.description: The sailor, finally returning home with bountiful treasures, takes a moment to rest. Lean back on the deck, and bask in the sweet leisure brought by the sea breeze and sunlight.

1005801.description: As all things wither, the entomologist's observations continue. Falling autumn leaves, curled-up insects, the steady growth of humus... How many secrets lie hidden in this quiet season?

1005802.description: As a child, they stumbled upon a Pearl Wings perched on the windowsill, its wings shimmering like a tiny starry sky under the moonlight. Captivated by this tiny dreamscape, they grew up to become an entomologist.

1005901.description: In the land where the Loong coils, dew scatters, and life stirs anew. Tender buds and blossoms emerge, quietly nestled within the unchanging world, untouched by time.

1005902.description: Wherever the Loong travels, mist vanishes, ice melts, and frost fractures into flowing streams. The frozen waterways turn into springs, following the Loong as it ascends into the heavens.

1006001.description: On a damp spring afternoon, the little animals chase each other and play on the grass. After their joyful playtime comes to an end, it's time for a good cleaning!

1006002.description: To commemorate a delightful afternoon encounter with a Shirtcat, this special design was created!

1006201.description: In the early morning, mist slowly spreads, and the Aurosa, not yet kissed by the grand radiance, quietly awakens in the faint light. It feels as though wishes are being born—still hazy and blurred—but still radiating a warm, soft glow.

1006202.description: Nestled among the lush foliage of the Millewish Tree, the tenderest leaves nurture the earliest whispers of Faewish Sprites. When the Aurosa blooms, these Faewish Sprites awaken from their slumber, spreading the divine power of wishes throughout the land once again.

1006203.description: In the shadow of the Grand Millewish Tree, the Aurosa, struggling to bloom, seems to be murmuring in suppressed tones, whispering tales of the sinister plots that lurk in the shadows.

1006204.description: Before the dawn broke, unprecedented darkness enveloped the world, where gods and mortals alike sang a sorrowful ode to courage. Amidst that eternal night, are the radiant Aurosa blooms also weeping for someone?

1006701.description: The forest has long sung the young girl's story—listener of the earth and guardian of nature, a bringer of hope and rebirth. The Great Lumie Tree she once healed still stands in silent grace between heaven and earth, bearing witness to the cycle of life.

1006702.description: She gathers the thoughts of all living things, weaving them into a melody. As the wind passes through, the forest creatures follow her rhythm, joining in a grand, one-of-a-kind symphony.

1008201.description: She had grown old, so old that her breathing was like the wind in a valley, so old that she could no longer journey far and wide. She wanted to give the little tailor an everlasting home, one with flowering vines for a roof and embraces for walls. It would be a home where, once she moved in, she would never have to move away again.

1008202.description: The flowering vine lived out its entire life upon the lapel, and the garment gained the colors of all four seasons. It was fresh green, deep crimson, and the silent snow white. The little tailor smiled as she put away her needle. This living garment was the most beautiful time she had sewn into the mortal world.

1008301.description: Rebuilding the ruins with shared wishes, the people of Florawish made new wishes for a fresh start after its revival... As they did so, little paper cranes flew into every corner of their lives.

1008302.description: The statue of The Wishing One, holding the Aurosa Scepter, has been officially unveiled as the reconstruction nears completion. People gather before the statue, making heartfelt wishes, hoping that Florawish will remain peaceful and serene forever.

1008401.description: Taste the soft, chewy gummy, its sweet flavor spreading throughout your mouth, making you forget all your worries. Welcome to the exclusive gummy treats at the Bowtie Cat's afternoon tea party!

1008402.description: Invited by the Bowtie Cat, I come to an afternoon salon where time seems to slow down. With the company of red tea, sweet cakes, dear friends, and the Bowtie Cat, the hustle and bustle of the outside world fade into the background.

1008501.description: Come on! Come see the Lorelei Troupe! The Troupe's name was making headlines in the papers, and Ennio still had his companions—his family—by his side. Back then, he never imagined parting ways. With a heart full of hope, he dreamed of what the next decade together might bring.

1008502.description: Familiar faces faded in the licking flames, the searing pain forever etched into his palms, his chest, and each sleepless night haunted by longing. Lorelei's ashes had scattered to the wind, but the new melody was steeped in a cost known to no one.

1009001.description: Far from home, the departed hope their homeland won't forget them, while forgotten garments stand as silent sentinels over those who journey onward. The wind blows through the Stonetrees, carrying wishes that turn into quiet guardians, drifting through the remnants of others' past lives.

1009002.description: As Lavenfringes bloom, and one by one, adorable Florist Sheep stroll leisurely among the flowers, the people of Prosperville finally start a vibrant new life.

1009201.description: On a dreamy afternoon nap, a gentle knock sounds at the door of the Bibcoon's Chuckle Club. Order a glass of mixed juice and set the stage for a laid-back afternoon dance party.

1009202.description: The joyful waltz at the Bibcoon's Chuckle Club is all the rage. It's said that the music draws inspiration from the songs of the Cadenceborn, while the dance steps mimic the playful spins of Bibcoons with their yarn balls.

1009301.description: The Starlit Breath believed it was lost in a magnificent daydream. Yet the butterfly, lingering patiently, silently whispered that, though she seemed insignificant, she was the most beautiful flower in its eyes.

1009302.description: In her autobiography, she recalls being immersed in a splendid dream. In this dream, spotlights hailed her as the sole protagonist. She was fully aware it was merely a captivating illusion, yet the allure of the dream was irresistibly sweet, trapping her as she roamed within, reluctant to awaken.

1009303.description: She understood that not everyone is the protagonist of the story; supporting roles are equally important. Like the dazzling lights in the night sky, they originate not only from the radiant big stars but also from countless twinkling small stars. Whether bright or dim, together they form this magnificent starry sky.

1009304.description: From standing at the edge of the stage to stepping into its center, she devoted a full decade. When myriad lights finally converged solely upon her, she had already become the unrivaled protagonist.

1009401.description: Memories spread recklessly within the heart, like an oath etched in cold stone beneath the blade's unforgiving edge. The vibrant ideals once born of love are now tainted with blood. Though a longing stirs to cross the hills of time and return to the past, the faces we once knew are no longer those of the youth we remember.

1009402.description: Deep within the vast expanse of the forest, a lingering sigh echoes—as promises shatter and gods fade into memory, only the gentle whispers of new life comfort the land once bathed in the moonlight's glow.

1009501.description: Daylight faded into the depths of night, starlight tucked away with rain in the lake's ripples. Along the journey, brief showers fell, and her drifting thoughts sang gently through the dark, ripening into fragile fruit.

1009502.description: As the last drop of rain falls, the sky transforms its hues, reflecting a peculiar glow upon the lake's surface. In the quiet moment, emotions shifted. The babbling stream led to the journey's beginning, and the seeds of thoughts sown would surely bear shining fruit.

1009601.description: On a night ablaze with drifting fireworks, laughter cannot disturb the orderly march of the Floofs. Amid the child's curious questions, an unyielding starlight blooms in her eyes, shimmering with the echoes of past vows and unwavering watchfulness.

1009602.description: When their eyes met, faded memories were reignited, and the past years came into focus once more. Floofs, line up! This time, standing together, looking forward to a brighter tomorrow.

1009701.description: As midnight blends with the shadows, the moment of invitation arrives quietly. Moonlight witnesses the confrontation between the Guardian and the mysterious figure beneath the night sky. Amidst the announcement of masks and smoke, a decade-long promise of reunion unfolds.

1009702.description: A friend from afar returns with a ten-year promise, and suddenly, the night feels brighter, the stars warmer. By the fire, they share old stories, hoping their friendship burns as warmly and endlessly as the flames before them.

1010101.description: Once every two centuries, the Aurosa blooms as promised, and countless dormant lives await their awakening. On this day, they bask in the radiant blessings and eager hopes. The miracles of the Millewish Sprite transcend time, inspiring the power of a new generation's wishes.

1010102.description: Long after, amidst the embers of war, the reigning Wish Master stepped into the long-forgotten sanctuary. From that moment on, the power of wishes and promises intertwined. Once, people relied solely on their strength to achieve their desires; now, he too was determined to fulfill his promises through unwavering efforts.

1010501.description: Once more, she awakens beneath the silvery-white glow of the moon. The lingering joy of dancing in her dreams sets her thoughts in motion. She picks up her pen, letting her emotions flow as she recounts the moonlit ball...

1010502.description: She had once spent countless nights lost in her dreams, writing the stories that flowed from them. But tonight, she finally had the chance to turn the melody she had danced to in her dreams into real steps beneath her feet. Under the starlight, she would become the star of the stage...

1010701.description: That deep water held all silence and echoes, yet it was nothing more than the briefest, gentlest ripple within the dazzling light.

1010702.description: An unknown biologist wandered into the Well of Fortune late one night and stumbled upon a spectacle he'd never forget: Monroefins and Croakers living in perfect harmony, weaving a mesmerizing night symphony.

1010901.description: It could not release the memory of that silhouette dissolving in the flames. In the void that followed, her presence vanished, and so it locked away a past consumed by fire. Through the long years, it has done nothing but piece together the fragments of memory, over and over again.

1010902.description: The long wandering finally reaches its end. It stops its searching footsteps. In the eternal silence, it seems to see that smile again, as bright as the very first time they met.

1011301.description: What cannot be found is gifted by dreams, and what cannot be reunited is woven by them. Once, beyond the clouds, an island appeared on the horizon, never to be dismissed as mere mirage. Guided by the traveler's melody, memories stir, and the island is dreamt of as though drifting through the depths of night.

1011302.description: The bewilderment following the hidden adventure transforms into a fairytale melody, as the legend of rainbows and bubbles is whispered through the golden wheat fields. When the music plays softly, it lingers, carrying the memory of a sweet dream resting among clouds.

1011401.description: With a cheerful step, she rings the bell in her hand, and the Florist Sheep bounces happily behind her. Just ahead, the picnic cottage stands ready.

1011402.description: After the revelry, would the quiet of everyday life take over? Yet, on another day, amidst the biting cold and snow, they would dance again. Snowflakes gently drifted, their footsteps light, and with each soft jingle of the shepherdess's bell, every day became one worth dancing through.

1011701.description: At the edge of the night, the morning star glimmered faintly, bearing witness to her quiet journey. Through the haze of longing and pursuit, tiny embers burned steadily, lighting the path toward the fireworks.

1011702.description: Day after day, she yearned for the spark that might one day ignite in her palm. Her longing would soon break free, shedding its restraints to rise toward its fated meeting with the sky.

1011703.description: The tide of fame and fortune surged toward her, but in the end, her choice mirrored the fireworks she cherished: shining brightly at its peak, then fading gracefully when the time came.

1011704.description: The dark night gifted her a pair of dimmed eyes, yet she longed to find a light that would burn eternal. Unable to summon flowers from the night sky, she instead gave her boundless and steadfast love. A small firework danced around her, warming her hopeful heart.

1012101.description: She closed her eyes, sinking into soft dreams, where the special adventure chapter began. The thoughts she couldn't finish during the day's journey were now entrusted to her dream-self.

1012102.description: Embarking anew with the dawn's glow, may this journey stretch on, for there lies a tapestry of vibrant landscapes beyond, waiting for us to discover together!

1012301.description: The fairy tale's sequel tells that, after time had quietly passed, the princess finally stepped beyond the castle gates. She rested gently on the grass, while the Bullquet roamed nearby, bringing her bouquets in its mouth.

1012302.description: Later, the story of the little princess continued to echo through Wishfield. It's said that once, someone saw the little princess and the Bullquet sitting together under the starry sky, gathered around a tea table, with starlight scattered across the hem of her flowing dress.

1012401.description: Warm winds whisper as the tree bends under the weight of its green fruit. Swarms of bees flit around Mila, their wings stirring the fragrance of the still-green fruit. Strangely, though they nibble on what remains unripe, their tongues already taste its sweetness.

1012402.description: Season after season, guided by the gentle hum of Foodie Bees, she uncovered the secret of sweetness, nurturing fruits as rich and golden as honey. Over time, the people honored her, bestowing upon her the cherished title of "Foodie Mila," in tribute to her dearest companion.

1012601.description: The lonely butterfly will always age in the desolate wind, endlessly devouring solitude. The seasons shift, bringing both decay and growth, yet the butterfly girl, forever alone, ponders this as she watches.

1012602.description: The lonely girl finds no one to confide in. As butterflies flutter all around, a gentle breeze caresses her dress. The breeze travels across vast seas, eventually transforming into a storm that shatters everything at the end of its journey.

1012603.description: Over those long years, a dense forest grew on the desolate island, and the frail figure with wings on her back fell into slumber within the sea of green blanketing the sky. Occasionally, the wind swept through the forest, echoing the flutter of wings.

1012604.description: Countless days and nights have passed, and the story of the butterfly and the desolate island has long been lost. Even the witnesses from that time are now in their twilight years. As the Queen prepares to close her eyes for the final time, the familiar dream seems to unfold in front of her once again.

1012801.description: It was a romantic wish, like the dark currents beneath a deep pool, wrapped in honey and fine sand. He bent down to listen, and from the depths, the lover's call echoed. Finally, transformed into a Silvergale perched upon a branch, he prepared to sing a song for his beloved.

1012802.description: In the stillness of the valley, the Silvergale chases a distant white figure with all His heart. His song resonates with a wish-turned-love, echoing endless devotion.

1012803.description: The moonlight softly graces the Silvergale's wings, bringing a gentle warmth to His wounded heart. Amid nightfall's shadows, cries and regrets layer in silence, hiding untold sorrows.

1012804.description: In a final, searing moment of longing, He holds His beloved close, hoping for a last kiss. At the crossroads of destiny where wishes and love meet, all He can give is this single kiss.

1012901.description: As the first soft light of dawn breaks over the horizon, the giant paper crane begins its journey, carrying wishes from beneath the Great Wishtree toward the place where they are stored. This is the most beloved and familiar sight for the residents of Florawish.

1012902.description: Countless wishes gather under gods' watch, paper cranes spreading their wings. In the span of time, these wishes turn to hope, stored in a vast space, awaiting the day a Faewish Sprite will carry them away.

1012903.description: A Grand Crane takes off from the high platform of the Dream Warehouse, soaring over forest-covered ruins toward the bustling, peaceful Land of Wishes.

1012904.description: Moonlight taps at the night's door, and countless paper cranes pause on the high platform of the Dream Warehouse, watching over the wishes and dreams of Florawish.

1013001.description: Beneath the clear sky, the strings hum, their melody flowing like a warm breeze blessing the beautiful afternoon.

1013002.description: The grand stage has drawn to a close, so now step gracefully into the forest, where listeners still await a serenade under the moonlight.

1013201.description: The headlights sliced through the darkness ahead, gravel rattling beneath the tires, as the cowgirl's swift motorcycle raced to match the rhythmic beat of the Bullquet's hooves. And so, another chase was set in motion.

1013202.description: In her deepest dreams, she and the Bullquet chase and play, their laughter rippling through every corner of the night.

1013701.description: Angelina sets aside the original script of "Perfect Idol." Carefully, she weaves a new story into a net of her own making, a wish-seeking journey that exists only in her imagination, entrusting wandering hopes to a pastry chef's uniform.

1013702.description: Spira finally awakens from its dream. Labobo and Roucoco exchange a glance and toss aside the old script in unspoken agreement. This time, they choose to tell a story of love and sincerity hidden within pastries.

1014201.description: Walking along the edge of the ballroom, the young girl leans gently against the window, a soft smile gracing her lips as she stands still. Though she no longer spins, the night clings to the hem of her gown, unwilling to let go.

1014202.description: As the bright lights of the ballroom fade from view, the girl steps gracefully into the courtyard, embraced gently by the night. Captivated by the enchanting scenery, she finds herself lost in its spell.

1014301.description: She hears the murmurs of the water, walking through the ebb and flow of desolation and abundance. She calls out the name of her homeland, and the waters respond with rain, wheat fields, and a silent, overflowing fullness.

1014302.description: What could be faster than the raging flames of war? She gazed at the surging river, then leaped in. "Take me with you," she whispered, "let me become the torrent that heralds the storm, so that all may hear the river's call."

1014501.description: The old sailor once witnessed the scene at sunset: the eighteen-year-old sailor scooping up the fiery gold from the tips of the waves with an iron bucket, while the fifty-year-old sailor captured the lingering glow of the mast's reflection in his wrinkles. In the folds of the surging waves, everyone could gather their own dusk.

1014502.description: As the old sailor recounts his encounters with her, his face betrays a hint of sadness mingled with nostalgia. It was the dawn of their tale, when he was but a novice sailor, often swaying unsteadily on the rocking deck, legs trembling beneath him.

1014503.description: "For any sailor with dreams of conquering the ocean depths, that treasure holds the key." The old sailor reminisces, his voice filled with the captain's fiery encouragement. "Grab your weapons, pack your rations, and fuel your resolve, young ones. Set sail and uncover that hidden treasure!"

1014504.description: As the raging storm shattered ships and summoned the specter of death upon the waves, this sailor defied the odds and returned home a living legend. But he declared that he would leave the deck behind, swearing never to embark on another journey far from shore.

1014601.description: Step by step, the opponent's king is cornered into an inescapable trap. Though it may seem like the game is unfinished, the outcome has already been sealed.

1014602.description: The cold light on the chessboard catches the eyes, outlining the confrontation between the red and blue squares, as a battle of wit and will is about to unfold.

1015101.description: When she ascended as the "sun," she finally realized the worth of past glimmers.

1015301.description: Clad in waterproof gear and boots, she steps into the rain, allowing the water to wash away her worries and fatigue. The world is renewed by the croaky chorus of Croakers, becoming light and fresh once more.

1015302.description: In Florawish, the glow of the perpetual streetlights and the warm light of the mayor's residence are as familiar as the night sky. To pay the utmost respect to those heroic Croakers who keep our power system running smoothly, the award-winning designer has introduced a surprise exclusive edition.

1015401.description: The lush, dripping vines wove a flat green carpet, with dewdrops and sunlight dotting the earth. Not yet an official fairy, she wandered lost in the forest and accidentally stumbled upon a secret fairy tea party.

1015402.description: In the boundless world of silver and snow, a lone figure trudged through the frosty wind. After a long time, she finally caught a glimmer of light. As frost blossoms bloomed at her fingertips, a faint magic began to flow like the Dreamspring for the first time.

1015403.description: The young girl fell into the abyss, but in her despair, a fairy lightly waved her wand, and a soft feather descended, lifting her up amidst a beam of clear light, dispelling the mist that clouded her dreams.

1015404.description: She once answered the call of her heart, eager to escape the cycle of apprenticeship. The final test of the dazzling fairy attire awaited in a distant land... This time, she is not alone. With companions by her side, she creates miracles alongside kindred spirits from another world.

1016001.description: As time wore on, the princess shed her youthful innocence and naivety. Having completed her etiquette studies, she emerged as a true graceful lady of the royal court.

1016002.description: After etiquette class, the little princess sinks into the soft embrace of her fluffy duvet. Just as sleep begins to settle in, her eyes are irresistibly drawn to the flickering fireflies dancing in the forest outside the window. In that fleeting moment, a bold thought takes root in her mind.

1016101.description: When the first light of morning seeps through the mist of the forest, the young flower fairy awakens from a century-long slumber, about to begin her short adventure.

1016102.description: The author's mind is forever etched with the memory of her childhood wanderings in the forest: the gnawing hunger after getting lost, the terror of stumbling upon the thieves' hideout, the heaviness in her legs during her escape... But those are the parts beyond the fairy tale.

1016103.description: As she recalled the moment when she finally broke free from the forest's grasp, the author's furrowed brow smoothed out. The warmth of those cherished memories enveloped her, and the very first sunrise after her narrow escape was deeply etched in her memory.

1016104.description: The author recounted the final chapter of the story: The unexpected blaze that ravaged the land forced the Flower Sprite to confront the devastating hand of fate for the very first time. In the end, amidst the ashes, hope sprung anew as the restored homeland flourished, with creatures cheering her on and blossoms crowning her in glory.

1016201.description: At the edge of the world, she dreamed. In the dream, the snow had not yet melted, and she had not yet grown up. Her people draped her in gossamer, and time itself blurred... How wonderful, for in that moment, she was no longer alone.

1016202.description: On the scorched earth, the snowbound realm has melted into a mirage, its purity consumed by the fierce flames, leaving even the gods in chaos. Her tears freeze into vows of cold ice, striving to shatter the chains of life and death. In this frozen world, they drift into an eternal slumber through the winter.

1016203.description: The wingless ever-blazing bird longs for boundless flight. The iceborn mermaid, unable to cease her song, yearns for her shattered homeland to be restored. At the world's edge, these two souls brimming with desire meet, exchanging a vow, offering their only wish.

1016204.description: The wind asks nothing of the past, and the Stonetrees mark no passage of time. Side by side, their shadows move through the changing light. No matter how the world transforms, or how the wilderness stirs, they remain hand in hand, ever drifting toward the horizon.

1016301.description: The evening clouds are her favorite new scenery. With a snap, the lens in her hand captures the shifting colors with perfect precision.

1016302.description: The chirping of insects at night chased away slumber, as the twinkling stars beckoned her on a quest. A faint fragrance wafted through the darkness, deeply captivating the girl's heart.

1016401.description: The tip of the brush leaped with brilliant light, and fantastical dreams took shape on the canvas, emerging into reality one by one.

1016402.description: Her brush gently caressed the canvas, sketching a mystical sea of stars. In her solo dance within the dream, she imagined the vibrant splendor of unknown worlds, her thoughts flying alongside shooting stars across the boundless sky.

1016501.description: In the fairytale "The Daughter of the Snow", the girl's hometown lies beneath a perpetual blanket of snow. The long, unyielding winter shrouds every hint of spring, leaving behind only the endless dance of fine snowflakes and the fleeting blush of rosy clouds to herald the season's arrival.

1016502.description: "The girl reminisces about her homeland," as depicted in the prologue of The Daughter of Ice. She cherishes the memories of her own world, reliving the frigid nights of her homeland. Even though the winds howled and snow raged that night, it remains one of her most treasured memories.

1016503.description: In the second volume of The Daughter of Ice, the girl bids farewell to her homeland and embarks on a long journey. She travels far and wide, ultimately reaching a city-state where spring's sunshine embraces the land with eternal warmth. Every step of hers on the foreign land is a testament to her adventurous spirit and anticipation.

1016504.description: Flipping through the pages, the collection of poems introduces a new chapter. The girl, now saturated with the sweetness of spring's embrace, finds her yearning for warmth intensifying. Her eyes gleam with a fiery passion that refuses to dim, a testament to her unyielding desire for more.

1016601.description: The meteors that lit up the earth once illuminated countless dreams, just as they shone upon the past, present, and future.

1016602.description: A meteor shower lights the skies over Florawish, just as it once did in an age touched by war.

1016701.description: They once shared dreams between the morning dew and the setting sun—dreams of pages and wheat fields, of distant lands and home. Now, though separated by distance, those years continue to grow, bearing rich golden grain that sways in the wind.

1016702.description: The wind that sweeps across the fields carries the lingering warmth of midday songs. Hand in hand, they walk down the familiar path home. Though this road has been traveled a thousand times, it now feels new, as the dawn breathes life into the faded reverie.

1017301.description: Where warblers sang in warm sunlight, the breeze through the grass carried the scent of herbs. East of the herb fence, west of the herb fence, one still remembered that promise made in the rain. Tender green shoots arched like slender brows, as a tiny butterfly came to rest among them.

1017302.description: Yin Yuan binds, compassion endures. Mother and daughter both chose to face the burden of healing all lives. With hearts clear and steadfast, they became like the pure moon in the sky, casting its light across every river and stream.

1017401.description: The story of the blind girl spread by word of mouth. Some called her a prophet, others a guide, or even a descendant of the divine. They wondered how clouded eyes could perceive tangled destinies, never knowing she had already seen the world through the sea.

1017402.description: A passerby once asked, "Blind girl who guards the sea, where does your own fate lead?" She gave no answer, only knowing that until the final moment arrived, all she could do was wait.

1017501.description: Ten million tales, ten million faces. Some called her a ghost, others a fairy. But she was no mystery to unravel, she was the answer history left behind as the wheel of time turned.

1017502.description: The mist concealed her face, time wiped away her trace, and ancient legends left behind only silent relics. A faded scale stirred countless emotions, carrying forward her selflessness and warmth.

1017601.description: Youth bloomed by day and faded by night; the rosy cheeks lasted but an instant, petals scattered on the water freely drifting. Yet trusted friends still looked back, and the painted world held its warmth. The heart finally found its peace.

1017602.description: The orchid boat glides where osmanthus oars part the mist's veil, through haze that swells and sighs without fail. Half-drowned in moonlit wine, the gazer sees two worlds align—lotus faces, hearts now twined, where jade waves wed cloud-torn skies in waters divine.

1017701.description: The dazzling starlit sky bore witness to countless miracles, awaiting the glow they would one day radiate across the world. On one special day, the shimmering wishes intertwined, weaving a surprise for a little birthday star.

1017702.description: As starlight fills the night, friends gather around the birthday girl, their laughter melting into golden ripples under the candlelight, spreading warmth to every corner.

1017801.description: The bird that once left the nest, fearful of loneliness, now bears frost upon her feathers as the north wind carves away her weakness. Pain solidifies into new wing bones, and she silently surrenders to the sculpting of wind and snow.

1017802.description: Why does she long for wings? Her thoughts rise and float toward the past. Does she wish to touch the sky or become a bird set free? Yet, deep inside, a softer voice lingers. More than flight, she yearns to be like everyone else, to be noticed, to be cherished.

1017803.description: The dark night always teaches her desire, compelling her to confront the truth. The bird that shuns judgment inevitably withers in a foreign land. She says, "My friend, do not mourn. I will offer you my final song. My soul shall be the sun that lights your path."

1017804.description: The legends whisper in the wind, recounting how flames, reflected in the frozen mirror, catch a glimpse of their own image. In the final season abandoned by the world, the migratory birds discover the path for their journey.

1017901.description: There was a time when her steps wavered, her heart adrift like a lone wanderer in an endless, uncertain night. But then, the lake shimmered softly, and the Pink Ribbon Eel swayed its tail, reigniting the forgotten embers of her inspiration. She picked up her dance shoes, took the first step, and let hope gently twirl in the stillness before dawn.

1017902.description: No longer drawn to the spotlight, she finds a glow behind the mist that recalls her first dance. When tears and sweat merge into new rivers, she swims toward the next shooting star, like a Pink Ribbon Eel chasing its dreams.

1018101.description: Under a night where neon lights weave and flicker, she drifts aimlessly, her gaze lost in the fading trails of falling stars. As dawn approaches, a quiet emotion stirs upon the lake's surface. In that moment, she realizes that the brilliant path she has been chasing is the very one she has been walking all along.

1018102.description: Endless shooting stars remain distant; neon-lit bays are now her haven. Once-wild plains and upstream struggles were destiny's softest trials. At last, the young fish hides her wounded heart in the night.

1018201.description: The curtain rose, spilling light over her trembling shoulders. Taking a deep breath, she danced with the soul of her role, her lines unfolding like wings. Applause surged like a tide as she lightly turned from the story, leaving only the soft pull of her heartbeat in her chest.

1018202.description: After the curtain had fallen, she continued performing alone in the empty street, the moonlight her stage and the stars her companions, spinning and spinning. At that moment, she realized this love belonged to her soul. She bowed to the world, both a curtain call and a beginning.

1018301.description: The bronze-colored clockwork came to a halt, the music fading as everything slipped into slumber. Only the moonlight and the potted plants on the windowsill stayed awake, keeping company with the solitary figure by the window.

1018302.description: The soft click of turning gears sets the music box's first symphony in motion—a melody dedicated to the moon that has yet to fade.

1018303.description: In a sudden shift, the ethereal tune blazes into fiery intensity, igniting the night like a sea of crimson blossoms. This variation is meant for passionate dances and hearts that burn just as brightly.

1018304.description: The rotating core awakens the gentle hum of gears, bringing the sleeping melody to life once more. This final rhapsody is dedicated to the dream that lingers between day and night.

1018601.description: It was a slow afternoon, with no thrilling leaps, nor a clear destination. Instead, there was a clear blue spring, carefree critters, and a traveler who put away the Sticky Claw and the weight of speed and purpose, if only for a moment.

1018602.description: "Whoosh!" A figure swung out from the sky-high branches and the misty morning light, rising with overflowing joy.

1019201.description: Even in the strictest days of childhood, there was always a comforting shade of green. It was the deer that tugged at the girl's dreams, guiding them through rainy seasons and into years lush with life.

1019202.description: "Girl who grew up on my back, what more can I give you? As I grow old and gray, you're just beginning to shine. If there's one last thing I can do, it's to help you chase the dream you held as a child."

1019701.description: It is said that when the silver-white full moon turns scarlet, the barren ruins will stir to life. As the ancient melody of the instrument fills the air, shadowy figures blur and dance with haunting grace—ushering in the grandest moment of the legendary ball.

1019702.description: Feel the gentle caress of the morning's first light, witness the brilliance of each glowing cloud—each moment a quiet farewell, slipping away from the grand ball at dawn.

1019801.description: As she grew up and left the towering city behind, her steps led her to a wilderness where soft breezes wandered and clouds slowly drifted over the horizon. At this sight, long-lost childhood dreams began to resurface in her heart.

1019802.description: When she thought back, even those quiet nights spent watching the shimmering clouds drifting by glowed faintly in the vast night of her memory.

1020101.description: Lantern light dances on freshly sewn garments. Golden threads are gently woven, carrying a wish that shines bright and endless. May this year be free of worries, and may we share in the beauty of the world together.

1020102.description: The joys of the early days are far from fading, as laughter and cheer fill the fragrant courtyard. The perfect time to wander is now, when the earth is draped in vibrant green. I long to share this beauty with you.

1020301.description: As the last notes of the banquet's closing melody fade, she steps gracefully onto a path woven from starlight and night. Bathed in the moon's flowing song, her presence takes with it the brilliance of the evening's constellations.

1020302.description: The moonlight filters through the gaps in the dense forest, scattering dappled radiance. The shimmering stars dance with the flowing hem of a dress, weaving a dreamlike and resplendent night.

1020401.description: Scarlet flames engulfed the city; the lone sword master bled, her blade failing. The artist's brush transformed fire into a thousand acres of autumn maples. Saddened, she painted the burning sky as dusk and scorched the earth.

1020402.description: One stroke splits the sky, ink still wet, mountains rise where green is met. I seem a guest within the scroll, a painted world, alive in heart.

1020501.description: She wished to bring warmth to Liniang and to shield her from every storm at sea. Yet the feelings entrusted in dreams and the waves held back in the tides fell into the mortal world, and in the end, none became true repayment.

1020502.description: At last, she understood the mortal bonds woven between the fishing lights. The best way to repay kindness had never been through gifts or proof, but by walking side by side through the long years and never leaving.

1020601.description: Why do what is known to be impossible? The girl stood at the dragon's feet and responded solemnly: Once she decides on something, she will not easily change it; this is the pride of being a knight.

1020602.description: Many years later, when refugees from afar stepped into the Boneyard, the dragon remembered her once more—perhaps even tiny humans can carry the weight of a dragon soul refined over a thousand years.

1020701.description: The flowing light purls away, a stream that cannot be chased; the soulmate of yesterday is nowhere to be found. The hazy moonlight of that hour was, after all, nothing but a phantom dream of the mortal world.

1020702.description: With weary wings, she settles within the tiered forests as the dawn light reflects across a thousand peaks. Only by letting go of her obsessions does she truly grasp the boundless vastness of heaven and earth. She offers her final dance to the mountain breeze; having found her true resting place, she is finally free to wander without restraint.

1020801.description: At last, she takes the long-awaited step forward. The city remains asleep, the world hushed, with only the steady echo of her heartbeat. She departs along the moss-covered path, moving quietly through the forest. As morning light filters through the trees, a distant manor emerges—silent, yet answering the unspoken longing within her.

1020802.description: Ripples form, carrying the scent of fine wine, gently drifting into her heart. The warmth of its intoxication spills over, nourishing her soul as it awakens.

1021301.description: Night's solitude faded beneath the dazzling fireworks, their splendor the only prelude to a grand tour. The pyrotechnic held their breath, crafting each burst to adorn the sky with a fresh bloom from the verdant wilds.

1021302.description: How many shows has the Fireworks Designer put on by now? Oh, never mind—it doesn't matter! A heart brimming with excitement craves adventure. Come, let's celebrate together on this wondrous night of unending fireworks!

1021401.description: In the little tavern, the food delivery device that had long stood idle once carried delicacies and laughter at every dawn and dusk. The former masters of this city are no more, yet the same laughter rings out once again...

1021402.description: The once glorious Titans have long since vanished into the river of time, yet the machines they forged still run according to laws written a thousand years ago, cycling endlessly without rest.

1021501.description: The final farewell descends in silence. The awakened soul turns to stardust, returning to the world. In the place where it vanished, new life begins to bloom...

1021502.description: Riding the "Lumie's Shadow" across the sky, leaping between mountains and clouds, and savoring the boundless joy of freedom.

1021601.description: In the castle shrouded by the forest, the slumbering little prince once dreamed of his distant homeland. It was a place of peace and tranquility, where the people lived happily and the shepherdess would sing a beautiful song as he passed through the meadows—though, alas, it was all but an illusion.

1021602.description: After enduring countless hardships, the little prince finally returned to his homeland. The strength and support of his companions had granted him a rebirth, and the light forged from courage and selflessness would ultimately crown him with the world's brightest glory.

1021701.description: Shadows coveting the gemstone lured her into drinking a draught of venom and deceit. They cursed her to hide her sharp edges, to turn herself into a tame bird. These soft, useless feathers and crimson shackles bind her to the earth; the gemstone will lose its loyal sentry.

1021702.description: Raising high the venom brewed of treachery, she tilted her head and drank it deep, walking toward the fires of hatred. She broke free from her chains, transforming into a giant bird that eclipsed the moon. The dreams in the thieves' minds, once as tame as downy feathers, are to be torn into shreds by an iron shriek, fertilizer that nourishes the forest.

1021801.description: Time flew by, and the girl who once chased Ambirds had grown. The big tree before the house burst with fresh green leaves, while blooming flowers trailed down the windows. With a bag on her back, she prepared to depart on a journey of learning.

1021802.description: The evening breeze swept across the table, stirring fallen petals and turning the pages just right to reveal the story of the little girl and the flowers.

1021901.description: Rectangular silhouettes intersect, veiling the faint contours of the horizon. Under the night's embrace, power lines extend in slender strokes, converging at the tip of her pen.

1021902.description: A cozy coffee shop with a sweet aroma can be the perfect place for inspiration: from noon till sunset, shadows shift, and her pen flows, filling every blank page with designs.

1022001.description: Who knows people's thoughts? Who knows people's dreams? Let me send a branch of longing, as the flowers of the old garden bloom late.

1022002.description: Thoughts adrift, dreams adrift. Leave behind the clamor, let it shift. Songs send clouds to eastern rift.

1022201.description: What was once home lay in ruins. The land sat in silence, devoid of life. But people hadn't lost faith in the eventual awakening of the gods that would bring sunlight and colors back to the forest.

1022202.description: The envoy walked alone through the night, until darkness swallowed them whole. Yet as life ebbed away, the hope within their heart blazed on, revealing a future where flowers blossomed across the once desolate land.

1022301.description: She sometimes wondered, perhaps if she could soften and make those fiery, aggressive colors gentle and cute, could people stop casting strange looks? But everyone knew that sugarcoating paper couldn't truly hide the bitterness of the medicine.

1022302.description: The moment she fell into the Illusion Zone, the prelude to the carnival began. Scissors and needles were set, a clock ticking away, as abandoned dolls gathered around a table. On this intoxicating night, the feast of delusion unfolded eternally.

1022303.description: From the first sight of the doll by the window, to finding it in the fields, and later witnessing its transformation into something brand new... the entire journey of encountering the Felispirit Sack was carefully recorded on manuscripts made from leaves.

1022304.description: Sometimes, she couldn't help but imagine the original form of the Felispirit Sack. In those days, its world was pure and flawless, and it was content to rest in the warm embrace of its owner. In its eyes, suffering was nothing more than a distant, obscure nightmare.

1022401.description: It lay forgotten in the ruins of the Golden Court, silently watching the world's rigid course until the chessboard was stirred by carefree, nimble steps, and it met the gaze of a vitality beyond the rules.

1022402.description: Its gaze no longer turned to the cold chessboard, but to the breeze passing through the gears, the newly blooming flower in the corner, and every chance encounter in life.

1022601.description: The deep night embraces all—eccentric pairings, unconventional designs, and even misunderstood thoughts and musings, each finding its place in the vast expanse!

1022602.description: The red moon rested upon the branch as the tailor twirled and danced. With the surging rhythm of the carnival, her movements grew ever more untamed—each spin and leap exuding an irresistible allure, drawing the attention of every Faewish Sprite.

1022701.description: Delicate petals of soft blooms gather on the canvas, forming a warm golden sea of flowers. The painter and the young girl stand side by side, each holding a brush, weaving their figures into the heart of the floral canvas.

1022702.description: Along a path scattered with wildflowers, she searched for unexpected moments hidden among the trees. She longed to etch a surprise in her heart, crafting it into an eternal oil painting that would never fade.

1022801.description: When will they meet again? Perhaps when she has read every scroll in the cabinet, when the migrating birds return, when flowers bloom upon the trellis, or when the Silken Lake sways once more to an old, familiar song.

1022802.description: The sunlight gradually fades, and the laughter and cheer of the crowd slowly fade away. As the sky transitions over time, the moment of farewell quietly arrives.

1023101.description: "How do you control your scales when you're emotional? How do you read someone's expression while speaking? How do you..." Her friend didn't answer. She knew that her kind and genuine heart would surely be embraced by others.

1023102.description: When war's flames swept across the land, the wheat fields sang a mournful song, soothing the grieving villages and bearing witness to the silent scorched earth. After many seasons, the wind would softly stir the fields again, and new seedlings would slowly ripen into gold.

1023103.description: Glimmers of unshed tears lingered over the ruins. Those who wept hid their pain deep inside. With her scales, she rescued a spark of hope from the disaster, easing the sorrow and opening a new chapter.

1023104.description: After traveling through countless towns and villages, the two rangers still held that snowy land in their hearts, where frost lay thick and cold winds whispered. Even beneath frozen soil, warm fruits could grow, quietly waiting through wind and snow.

1023201.description: Far away from here lies a sea of flowers, and those returning to their hometown are greeted by its fragrant embrace. If you see the girl bathed in petals like rain, ask her to weave a promised flower crown for you.

1023202.description: Even a withered flower can bloom again with fresh rain. Even a ruined town can shine once more with hope and love. In the days ahead, quiet anticipation will always take root and grow anew.

1023401.description: Was it a dream? From the mist emerged an enormous green bird, its sweeping tail trailing violet lights that shimmered like twilight beneath the dome. Drawn by the drifting haze, the girl wandered on until she reached a painted vision—a boundless field of pale purple flowers, swaying gently in the wind.

1023402.description: One night, flames flare up unexpectedly, consuming every green memory and leaving only endless gray-black stillness. She wipes her tears and looks toward the distant ashes—something stubbornly flickers, bright against the darkness.

1023501.description: I will not forget, I will not go numb, I do not want the princess in the story, crowned in a land of war. I want to light the lamps, I want to steal the fire, I want my heart to stay in tomorrow, to nourish the saplings that will one day scrape the sky.

1023502.description: Freedom, freedom, please hear her proclamation. She gave her all to let the song of resistance ring through the kingdom. She ignited the throne, burning away the smoke and the fires of war. Thereafter, the long night birthed the first dawn, and freedom echoed across the land.

1023801.description: Stepping into the ivy-covered, balloon-adorned candy workshop, she felt as if she had fallen into a green whirlpool. The old factory owner picked a candy ball from the jar and handed it to her, saying, "Careful, this sour candy will make your cheeks tingle."

1023802.description: She placed the round dough into the oven. "Ding!" The sweet aroma slowly filled the kitchen. Turning around, she discovered a balloon party set up by her loving parents.

1023901.description: As the silhouette stretched and laughter drifted further away, after today's farewell, who knows when they'll meet again? The final notes of the unfinished story fell softly at her feet, just a quiet echo of ever-growing longing.

1023902.description: Through countless days shared together, they dreamt of all that could be, planning the faraway stops of their future tour. She watched youthful clouds drift on the breeze, and the endless blue sky shone as brightly as her ideals.

1023903.description: A lost soul inscribed false incantations with an eternal vow. Her image and voice were sealed in this form, imprisoned in time's permanent bloom: trapped, unchanged, until the end of time.

1023904.description: From within the flames, a voice seemed to sigh and ask, "Lorelei's brightest rose, why must you bloom alone on this stage, in this fire?" And she answered, "Because this is the final refrain of my life."

1024101.description: The sky does not exist for the sake of the land, and Starsilk Fish do not need Whim Pedals. It is the simplest truth, yet we so often forget: beauty's dance needs no comparisons for shoes.

1024102.description: Within the illusion lies a true answer, or perhaps the answer is an illusion, and this realm is real. The Honeybunny's question and the vision of crimson candy now gather absurdity into the palm, allowing the searcher to claim this priceless treasure.

1024301.description: Ancient trees loomed, and dreamlike life unfolded. In a realm veiled in deep emerald mist, a wraith quietly laid her game. Vines entwined, the setting sun slanted low, and unseen bonds took hold. Stones spread like stars, awaiting the one who would enter the game. Was it all an illusion or the truth?

1024302.description: With one exultant game, she cleaved mountains and swallowed seas. A half-life of bitter obsession melted like ice into smoke; rolling river waters washed the dust of the past away, while stars, moonlight, and drifting rosy clouds painted her new robes. Dead wood budded with spring, a lost game stirred back to life, and at last she glimpsed the vast world beyond.

1024401.description: When it was just a tender shoot, its rustling leaves answered the girl's call. Grown into a lush canopy, it sheltered her from the wind and rain with clouds of blossoms. Even when only a stump remained after the disaster, its rings still kept secret words. In the end, its wood was carved into a fan, and it showered her with petals as they parted.

1024402.description: Say not this life betrayed a devoted heart. The peach blossoms weep blood for a reason. A single hairpin, a single fan, both hiding old vows. In the next life, destined souls will meet again. True love in this world flows on and on, life after life, never-ending.

1024501.description: She drew a strand of starlight from the Milky Way and shaped it into a warm lantern, unwilling to keep such brilliance to herself. She hoped it would guide travelers cloaked in frost and snow, its light reaching across miles of the mortal world.

1024502.description: From her hands, a thousand lanterns bloomed, their flames mirroring the sky. Remembering that moment beneath the lights, her eyes shone—bright as the moon breaking through clouds. Warmth settled in her palm as the lantern rested there, moonlight filling her thoughts, her heart anchored in this life.

1024901.description: Born into a land of unrest, she was mortal yet bore a heart of compassion. She lifted the guiding light herself, carrying a single flame across a thousand miles. Though the lands she crossed remember her no more, the heavenly maiden's name endures—her virtue passed down through generations, her light still shining among the stars.

1024902.description: The auspicious hour arrives, and the tribute is complete. A hundred days of patient, focused labor have brought countless forms into harmonious unity. It raised no grand altar for gods, but traced the ordinary lives of every household. When the self is set aside, the forms of all beings emerge; when empty fame is forsaken, the work becomes an enduring praise of life itself.

1025001.description: She dreamed a long dream: sunlight spilling from the sky, clouds drifting aimlessly, rain flowing gently along the river, milk and honey treasured in every home, and the wind carrying the fragrance of fine wine...

1025002.description: Due to the clear skies and bouquets in the picture book, the two sisters pushed open the doors of fate. The elder sister's eyes shone with distant starlight, while the younger guarded a dream woven from sunlight. The clouds still hung low, yet their carefree childhood had gone, never to return.

1025003.description: One petal chased the sunlight along the path, never returning; another counted the morning dew in a dream. If parting is the inevitable taste of chasing dreams and growing up, at least they once shared the same blossom.

1025004.description: She leapt from the high tower into cloud and rainbow, her countless thoughts scattering like shattered rain on the wind. Passion, reluctance, even fear—she broke through the storm, and when she looked back, the tallest spire of Rain City was no more than a speck.

1025101.description: She stood barefoot along the ridges of the field, quietly listening to the pulse deep within the soil. The evening wind brushed across the heavy wheat grains, rustling softly. In her eyes there was no more weariness, only the moonlight illuminating the harvest.

1025102.description: Once, time had seemed endless. Now, it felt fleeting. Amid the crowd, she recalled countless stages, and on each one, countless versions of herself. The golden harvest before her had already given her the right answer to her heart's question.

1025201.description: She walked barefoot along the edges of the fields as usual, her gaze sweeping across the green ridges. Planting season had passed; the busy fields had fallen quiet. In her heart, that quiet meadow opened its first seam to the wind.

1025202.description: The last rays of sunlight retreated from the fields, and the night sky gently kissed her and the wheat beside her. She gazed at the stars, unsure whether she wished to be a rooted grain or a wandering star.

1025601.description: With a light twirl, a star escapes the sleeve of the galaxy, and the gem falling from the hem accidentally strikes an unknown destiny. Wait no longer, hesitate no more—run toward the one you love beneath tonight's shimmering moonlight.

1025602.description: She took off her reading glasses and tucked the needle and thread she had used for half a lifetime into an old drawer. The formal gowns still hanging quietly in the shop were like unsent love letters. Some were sweet, some solemn, but all held a gentle silence, accompanying each person as they found their own path into the future.

1025801.description: You silently drifted away on a hidden evening breeze, taking all fragrance with you. Yesterday's reflections froze into chains beneath my feet. Grandmother, how I longed to rest forever in your last smile. I thought I would never find a dream garden scented with your presence again.

1025802.description: New flowers quietly grew atop memories tied to you, and their familiar fragrance finally freed me from the old mire. I set forth from the past toward the horizon, seeds marking my footsteps, and my homeland resting in my heart.

1025901.description: She was a shooting star streaking across the sky, awakening hidden stars along the distant cape in quiet resonance. The "Cheer Dance" reflected countless shimmering universes in everyone, each glowing with its own brilliant light.

1025902.description: Before her stage debut, she'd often imagined shedding the role of "fan" to become an idol. But when she finally saw herself beneath the radiant lights, so small, yet shining so brilliantly, she made a choice: to cheer for herself for the rest of her life.

1026101.description: The girl stepped into a forest soaked in morning dew. At last, she saw with her eyes a hidden realm veiled beneath a gauze of mist. Deep within the woods, a poem sealed by time seemed to murmur softly.

1026102.description: The forest whispered its past to the girl. Long ago, an unnamed soul gave their life to purify the land. Beneath the moon, vows were sworn, inscribing a sealed legend into an eternal poem. Generations carried that undying glimmer, nurturing a future that slowly took root.

1026301.description: If the world had not fallen into silence, if the gods had never left, would the forest have remained green and prosperous to this day, fostering all life?

1026302.description: Echeros, who could not abide the clamor of the mortal world, resided in the serene forest. Through the silent passage of time, the lonely god was accompanied only by Their descendants, and Their creations.

1026303.description: Echeros was consumed by the wailing tides. Before the torrents of fate, Their anguish was no more powerful than mere ripples. All that was living was destined to return to nothingness.

1026304.description: Echeros once stood at the edge of oblivion, where death consumed glimmers of life like an abyss. The light of life kept pouring in like a flood, ever shining and never ending.

1026401.description: Looking back on the endless growth, laughter and joy have woven hope into the new Springblooms. Within each petal lies the promise of tomorrow, as the harmonious symphony of life unfolds across tranquil waters.

1026402.description: In the stillness of night, the Springbloom slip into a deep, untroubled sleep. From the depths of a dream-filled realm, illusions dance to a hidden rhythm, and a quiet order begins to unfold. Can you hear its whispers? The flowers, blooming in their quiet way, are dreaming ancient, forgotten dreams.

1026501.description: As that splash of pink appeared once more, long-dormant memories stirred. They gathered around her footsteps, lighting the path to the truth. For the sake of hope, they feared nothing and regretted nothing, even if they burned through their bodies and gave their final spark of radiance.

1026502.description: Loss, it seems, is but a mark etched by growth. They had already fulfilled the expectations of the god. Following the memory of how they were once protected, the Lumies now watch over the Parksolians and this tide-swept Boneyard.

1026503.description: The ancient sound of the tides once more washes over the Boneyard, and the Lumies can almost hear the sweep of dragon wings across the sky. They yearn for that grand journey of the past—for the majestic sights that will never be seen again.

1026504.description: His life was once as lush as a great tree, yet it eventually withered like a dried leaf. Still, He gently promised them a future—dawn would come at last, and with it, the flowers would bloom.

1026801.description: Have you ever seen a rainbow swirling in steam? Have you ever seen lightning take up residence in a crucible? In the palm of her hand, miracles leave a trail. In her arms, plants babble their first words. When she smiles, the laboratory bursts into bloom; when she smiles, all fairytales sprout.

1026802.description: She runs through shifting shadows and dappled light, leaping barefoot over brooks and climbing vines by hand. Her racing feet will never rest! Her free heart will know no fear! She belongs not to the paths of yesterday, but to every wild, sprawling tomorrow.

1026803.description: In that strange, frozen wasteland of dreams, she forgot everything. Silver light pricked from her fingertips; her back arched into a crescent moon. Who am I? Am I still myself? The darkness did not answer, using only a deeper silence to wait for the moonlight to stitch together the silhouette of a wolf.

1026804.description: She remembers that farewell, when the forest was still like an innocent child, dreaming of berries and fireflies. She is going to faraway lands; by the time she returns, she will be fully grown. She is going into the distance, and no matter how long it takes, the forest will remember.

1027901.description: Silence streamed between them. Memory climbed their faces like creeping vines. They both pursued illusory dreams, and nearly lost themselves. In that instant, they both sank into the innocence of their pasts.

1027902.description: Open your eyes, even if the path ahead is not smooth. Listen carefully, even to cries of pain. Life may strike us with suffering, but we answer it with the courage to face it!

1028201.description: The dancer danced with the Shroomlings all night by the cabin, her passion slowly opening the door to the reclusive girl's heart. The dancer spoke of fun and amazing tales from across the land, but the girl only responded with silence and sighs.

1028202.description: The dancer wanted to free the girl from fate's shackles, but the girl didn't want to slow down the dancer's carefree steps. When they eventually parted, the girl finally told her life story, her eyes briefly filled with hatred and regret.

1028601.description: Under a veil of darkness, a neat line of Shroomlings traversed the forest toward the warm lamplights of Spira, when their leader got lost and led them into a Behemoth's territory...

1028602.description: After growing giant, she should take every step carefully to avoid stomping on plants that are doing their best to grow. It's also necessary to practice how to hold back a sneeze to avoid startling fledglings just learning to fly.

1028701.description: She shone like a speck of light in the cold night, drawing countless fragile creatures close. With quiet resolve, she wove the tremors and silences of the forgotten into her dance, leaving tender footnotes for all the neglected souls.

1028702.description: The life of the Weavespider ended quietly in its delicate web, yet the unfulfilled sensations surged again in her heart, composing a new prelude. Her dress swirled like a full moon, dancing gracefully—not for the stage, but because she had found her home.

1028801.description: The butterfly reduced to ashes in the flames chooses a brief yet incandescent extinction. Such brilliance, paid for with death, cannot be replicated by any gold thread or jewel. Yet that figure plunging into the fire has already become a spark that falls into her heart and ignites into wildfire.

1028802.description: She travels alone for thousands of miles to the Boneyard, only to ease a lingering regret. When she finally sees the freely dancing butterfly, she suddenly understands that this, too, is fate's revelation, calling her toward a storm of her own.

1028901.description: The flames that once consumed her home had long been extinguished, leaving only ash-strewn ruins. Yet why did that scorching, piercing pain still clutch at her heart every night, forcing her to lift her gaze in search of a vague, empty destiny?

1028902.description: The sky above the dome resembled the palace, equally high and equally changeable. A single rain would wash away the dust, along with the blood of the innocent.

1028903.description: For whom did she work? To whom should she pledge allegiance? Which flag should be torn, whose hearts shattered, and which lies preserved? Across what trail of blood should she advance?

1028904.description: Throughout this journey, she was soaked in the entanglement of good and evil, witnessing the clashes of sword and steel. She had come filled with hatred, yet departed embracing a heart without regret.

1029001.description: When do the flowers become immortal? When the Parksolians sing the tales of the dragons by the campfire, when the towering dragon bones turn into rolling mountains, and when the immortal will flows through their blood. The death of the dragons is not a farewell; they have gained new life in another form.

1029002.description: When do the flowers sprout? At the moment the God of Reincarnation breathed a wisp of Their vast radiance into the world, the newborn dragons broke from their shells. Their sacred teachings were buried like seeds deep within those newborn souls; there, the mission of guidance took root, silently awaiting the hour of its bloom.

1029003.description: When do the flowers awaken? When ripples rise again in the Cradle of Reincarnation and the newborn God of Reincarnation opens innocent eyes. The dragons return the teachings of the past like a flowing stream, and the swaying sea of flowers witnesses another inheritance of the mission.

1029004.description: When do the flowers wither? When the long watch exhausts the last of their strength, the dragons' scales lose their luster and their souls are soaked in impurity. They look back at the path the God of Reincarnation walked, and then follow it without hesitation, even if the road ahead is destined for extinction.

1029201.description: Rushing waters quenched the endless heat. Amidst ceaseless searching, she paused at last, gazing toward possibilities beyond the verdant green. She carefully sketched the contours of every wall, and slowly, everything there began to take shape before her eyes.

1029202.description: She stood amid the vast desert, like a traveler between eternity and infinity, seeking to understand how life, both singular and enduring, drifted, transformed, vanished, and finally became the landscape before her.

1029301.description: She wished to consume the gentle past like eating a ripe fruit, letting it melt within her, so she might live alongside the forest and sunlight, quietly growing into a tree, sharing her life story with the sky.

1029302.description: Since then, she had learned to cherish every sunset. Uncertain when parting might come, she savored the radiant glow while walking side by side with those she held dear.

1029303.description: Her body stretched, life blossomed, and regrets faded. Longing condensed into the fleeting span of growth. Then, she swiftly ran to embrace the new season of life.

1029304.description: She buried her regrets in the moist soil, wandered through the tranquil Forest of Slumber, draped warm memories over her burgeoning fur, and stepped alone into the depths of the woods.

1029401.description: The second child made a wish to understand the language of the forest, so green leaves and strands of hair were woven into a necklace around his neck. But when praise raised him as the embodiment of the harvest, could those listening ears still hear the forest's cries?

1029402.description: The third child longed to become the bravest hunter, so the fairy gave her a red fruit. But when the glory of strength blinded her, where would the heart that once vowed to protect all things finally fall?

1029403.description: By the time tales of the fairy rode the wind to the Shroomlings' ears, they were already shrouded in terror. In the forest, they warned one another: "Never speak with the fairy! She would trample your will and toy with your feelings!"

1029404.description: "The wind is my breath, the grass my skirt. Fish swim through my body, and Behemoths are my kin. I remain ever the same, yet my face often changes." The riddle became the answer he had waited for all his life, and that answer had always been in his heart.

1029501.description: Inspired by the umbrella bearer, the girl gently unfolds the story of Elderwood Forest, stepping into a whimsical world where everything is larger than life. There, she becomes a tiny, cherished sprite from a fairy tale. Towering trees stand guard, solemn and strong, shielding her from the elements and wrapping her in a profound sense of safety.

1029502.description: Night fell, and the fairy tale came to an end. The girl returned to the weary roof over her head, yet dreamed the sweetest dream she had ever known. In that dream, she returned once more to the moment beneath the umbrella, when someone had reached out a hand to her. This time, she did not miss it. This time, she reached back.

1029601.description: The old leaves had gone cold, but new saplings had already broken through the soil. Old glories had fallen silent, but new greens had inherited their undying resolve. The forest still stood, silently watching a new cycle of verdant vitality.

1029602.description: Cold frost muffled the echoes at the heart of the forest, letting old ruins rest in peace. Even though time had changed, those tales would sound out once again when snow fell, reminding visitors that the past had never truly vanished.

1029801.description: Forest, O forest, tell me. Why must I hold this warmth that lies outside our pact? Is this a punishment or a gift? Why am I both sad and joyful? How long until this brand upon my soul leaves me? Tell me, please tell me...

1029802.description: Look, the oldest fable has already turned a new page. Look, she and the hearth have lit your new face. You no longer have nightmares, and no longer have sorrow. Tick-tock, time proclaims the truth to desire. From this moment on, you are her.

1029901.description: She once considered herself a mere observer, drawn to the quiet treetops, turning her back on the clamor of the forest. But when she saw the ancient tree scarred by the axe, and a dying fledgling wail beside its toppled nest, she could no longer remain indifferent. How could she not resolve to protect them?

1029902.description: Countless lives brushed past her, unspoken yet united in guarding the forest; strangers yet aligned on the same invisible threads. Like kindred spirits, they resonated under the same stars.

1030001.description: The child did not yet know why all things withered and flourished, or why the birds had flown away. She simply lifted her face and wondered blankly: where were people meant to go, and who was she meant to become?

1030002.description: So be it, so be it. A fate with broken wings can only wait to freeze, cocooning itself in silence, yet never seeing the day it emerges.

1030003.description: That fire seeped through the cracks into her wing bones, and the bright wish she made as a child was finally tempered into a blade. If pain was sharp enough, could it stand in for the self that had long since blurred?

1030004.description: The god's daughter once saw a god's duties as where she belonged. When she stumbled to the end of fate, countless mirrors had finally peeled away, and she met herself again. In that moment, all dreams suddenly weighed less than a feather.

1030101.description: Do those souls who journey to the other shore sense a touch of coldness? Do they feel lonely, and thus fear that dark, frigid death? Until that day, golden flowers burst from the ground like a newborn dawn, lighting the path before them.

1030102.description: A century ago, a stylist gathered the legendary golden miracle flowers and transformed them into ceremonial attire to guard the cycle of rebirth. From then on, every witness who wears it soothes the wandering dead with a gentle heart, carrying an ancient legacy forward through time.

1030103.description: In the long years of watching, the girl chosen as the witness refuses to remain silent as souls depart. She arrives with her instrument, letting its strings pierce the night. Dark garments conceal her form, while the wind-like melody lets wandering souls hear a long-forgotten echo on their final journey.

1030104.description: Souls are like flowers that wither and pass through rebirth, becoming new buds rising from the soil. Medael once believed this without doubt. She once fell into despair as well, until at last she looked back at the world and saw that unfading spring.

1030201.description: The bard wove this cycle of life into a verse, for all who could understand it. She said, "Having heard the spring dew shatter upon the moss, having witnessed horns bloom into flowers, each sound of the tambourine honors those who depart and blesses those who arrive."

1030202.description: It was a chance, and it was inevitable. A melody awoke from her fingertips, a line of verse roused the forest. One life, and another life—melody and verse spoke their hearts. It was a rapturous, golden dance, so intoxicating that the night forgot the passage of time.

1030401.description: A storm that blotted out the sky arose when the god lost control. Before the newly erected tombstones, a new thought took root in Asna's heart—could human strength stand equal to the gods?

1030402.description: It was an unparalleled golden age. The radiance of the Heart of the City shone over the Golden Court, and surging energy never ran dry. Yet the brighter the glory burned, the deeper and darker the shadows on its underside grew...

1030403.description: Even immortal gods may fall. Echeros had long grasped the Titan race's irredeemable tragedy and foresaw the end that was certain to come for him. Gods and mortals alike shall return to nothingness.

1030404.description: A civilization once radiant vanished at the height of its glory. The city, fallen into slumber, was woven into legend. O traveler from afar, have you ever heard of the Sleeping Golden City?

1030701.description: The pink fruits are nearly ripe, filling the garden with a rich fragrance. But what if it suddenly starts to rain? Momo quickly replies, "Hurry, put raincoats on the trees!"

1030702.description: When the rain stopped, a shooting star streaked across the sky. Momo looked up just in time to see its luminous trail fading, painting the night in shimmering stardust. Beneath the glittering expanse, Momo closed his eyes and made a little wish.

1031301.description: It was the perfect rock experience. Synths, snares, noise, and a crowd brimming with unstoppable passion. Let chaos reign! We've got youth and freedom to burn!

1031302.description: Can rock break its own boundaries? Blend in the languor of jazz, the breath of blues, and the pull of pop. Hmm, maybe it's worth a try...

1032001.description: On the path to inheriting the pastry legacy, her mother's recipes had grown into an insurmountable mountain. She felt trapped within the familiar sweetness and memories. Her mother's shadow loomed over her, obscuring her own self...

1032002.description: Morning light brushes the edges of her dreams. She begins rewriting her own recipes. The moment her pen touches the page, the long-missed thrill floods her like a tsunami, as if she's back in those afternoons baking with her mother—the air sweet, the oven warm.

1032201.description: The boundless land unfurled in nature's frame, where sunset bled through mist in gold and jade's bright flame. Before this scroll, her soft song rose with ease—sip by sip, she drank heaven's perfect peace.

1032202.description: In water-cloud villages where maple fires glow, ink cascades drunk in waves' hypnotic flow—each brushstroke dreams of homeland's grace, where miles of river-mountains fill a single space.

1032401.description: Chasing butterflies fluttering in pairs, seeing the brilliant daylight turn into twinkling stars, the lost Shroomling danced a waltz with the Mothershroom's spore shower. However, this adventure has yet to conclude...

1032402.description: While guarding the Mothershroom, the Guardian Beast sensed an "invader" and charged toward the source, ready to fight, only to find a Shroomling from a bug-catching squad who got too absorbed in the task and wandered into Mothershroom Woods by mistake.

1032601.description: The starry night listened to her wishes, gently responding in kind. The girl reached out her hand to the sky, and the ever-glowing starlight condensed in her palm.

1032602.description: The boundless Sea of Stars wove infinite dreams around her, with the hem of her dress spinning an eternal celestial story. The young girl held fast to the starlight of hope, and no matter how treacherous the road ahead, she would press forward, driven toward the next unwritten adventure.

1032603.description: The magnificent auroras shimmered across the vast sky, and the birth of the universe was but an accident. However, within that accident, countless beautiful miracles collided. Civilizations fell and were reborn, but only beauty and love carried an eternal definition.

1032604.description: Stars collapsed into black holes, shattered into rivers of light, and hope vanished in flames. The girl stood amidst the infinite Sea of Stars, gazing at the final, lonely nebula. The universe had shown her both its vastness and its emptiness—yet it also gave her the courage to face the unknown without fear.
