1032701.description: As night quietly fell, the earth slowly drifted into a deep slumber. The purifying arrow zoomed across the deep darkness, noiseless and traceless, aiming to reawaken the slumbering hope and bring the long-awaited dawn.

1032702.description: The sun set, the wind slowed, and the forest basked in the afterglow. A purifying arrow pierced the orange haze, silently hurtling toward its destination to uncover an answer hidden far away.

1033001.description: With a single bow, It cradled a fallen child in a gleam of scales. After, moonlight gained warmth, and the mountain wind learned to pause. In the end, It chose to pursue the human world.

1033002.description: White Loong lifts moon from water's face, yet lingers still, one step too late. Ripples shimmer cold and pale, their glow spares not the one astray. Where ink has dried and wells run bare, a lone scale's path returns in vain. The silk, untouched, remains unstained, while silver tears fall night by night.

1033003.description: Danqing flows from the brush's tip, each year new strokes grace hopeful eyes. Though thousands echo past intent, none match first ink on fresh silk.

1033004.description: What is Yin Yuan in this world? Is it forgetting past vows, or being forever parted between heaven and earth? All threads of fate hang incomplete, and only weary hearts remain. If this tower of red silk can be burned as a fuse, can the heavens themselves be defied?

1033101.description: The misty smoke faded away, leaving only pavilions and towers, with grass and trees swaying in the unchanging breeze. A pale pink nimble cat sat among the shaking willows, listening to the silent world. Until, wandering past all living things, she finally heard the vibrant pulse of life.

1033102.description: Cold moon and warm sun wore down the passing time, until the homeland's fading blood settled into peaceful memory, and the cycles of grass and trees sang songs of joy. She witnessed the rise and fall of Yin Yuan, finding ordinary life in every painted scene.

1033103.description: At the Yin Yuan Festival, laughter and joy caught the girl's bright gaze. She passed through bustling streets, and when the music ended, only the cool dusk remained. Knowing she must part, she hoped to ease her friend's sorrow with kind words before bidding farewell.

1033104.description: Sitting opposite, gazing into her eyes during quiet games, they once shared countless eternal dreams. But like flowing water and falling flowers, life was full of long regrets. The girl spoke no comfort of reunion, only soft laughter, hiding her longing in a moonwhite Fortune Stick.

1033201.description: The moment she signed her name on the contract, she knew: luck and talent alone would not be enough. Her dream never wavered, but she longed to shine brighter, and to bring more joy with her voice. Then, her name would echo through every street and alley.

1033202.description: Dreams? They are the tears of yesterday that water today's growth. They are the wings grown through pain, crashing toward a sky so blue it hurts. They are the nights of dancing and singing till your throat goes hoarse. They're the doorway she finally found: brilliant, unknown, and full of light.

1033301.description: Thought forgotten and unknown, light suddenly broke through the dark willows—a wanderer returned. A false birthdate could not hold such deep sincerity. The heart's chaos worsened like catkins drifting in late spring. If there was regret, it was hard to explain or undo.

1033302.description: She once mistook true hearts for hollow words, misjudging depth with fleeting eyes. But no great harm was done, no bitter end cast. Regret came not too late. In the ever-turning world, where right and wrong blur like dust in wind, their bond endures, and when fate allows, they shall meet again.

1033401.description: The jubilant performance occasionally paused, while the quiet spotlight flowed like a breathing ocean, as the singer and audience shared a precious moment of calm together.

1033402.description: The dazzling aurora tore the night sky open with shimmering gaps, and the girl's song echoed like the Milky Way, descending softly into the mortal realm.

1034601.description: Seated quietly in her wheelchair, she gazed at the figure gliding over the ice—freedom surging in her veins yet still out of reach, and a gown seemingly woven of ice and snow.

1034602.description: She stood poised at center rink as a thousand lights converged. In the breath before the music began, she seemed to glimpse a small figure in a wheelchair, crossing time to watch—eyes bright, fixed on the person she had become.

1034801.description: Every meeting is a boon of fate, every star a bearer of infinite hope. The Seer walks, leading a sea of stars that shines forever, much like the determination in the young girl's eyes.

1034802.description: Memories of Wishfield adventures remain as vivid as ever, recounting celebrations of new life and tears of sorrow. Every hardship was a trial of growth, every moment a testament to the power of friendship. May all the blessings gathered along the way brighten the path ahead.

1034901.description: There were countless long nights where only the moon was watching. In the cold, golden reflection, she experienced a dream of nothingness, again and again.

1034902.description: From the silence, a girl was born. When her eyes were greeted with the first ray of sunlight, she felt lost, unsure of why she came to be, and unable to recall where she should go.

1034903.description: From the ashes, a lie was born. No one knew it to be the ember of old flames. Even so, she tried to reforge the name of truth from the ashes.

1034904.description: Facing the girl with the Heart of Infinity, she revealed her identity, her mark—her destiny.

1035001.description: With her eyes closed and hands clasped, she was the divine maiden entrusted with hope, destined to bring back their god one day. Green shoots sprouted, trees flourished, and the ceaseless prayers from the tower at last became a miracle, descending through her lips.

1035002.description: Illuminated by the moon and accompanied by whispers, she was the divine maiden who prayed for her people and followed their god's teachings. The cold stung, emptiness spread, and in the tower above, she devoted herself to her people, her sincerity unknown. From then on, the world would forget her joys and sorrows.

1035003.description: Golden light shimmered, wheat waves stretched endlessly, she was the divine maiden destined to bring back their god, to restore the eternal prosperity promised by the divine. Scars snaked across her skin, her black hair withered, yet no one noticed the face she offered to the god in the tower above. From then on, the world would forget her face.

1035004.description: Prayers twisted and dark currents surged, she was the divine maiden who tore through falsehoods, destined to ignite the flames of vengeance. The tower shattered, the kingdom fell, and no one heard the anguished cries of those struggling amid the ruins. From then on, the tower would no longer hold the divine maiden offering prayers.

1035101.description: The adventurer never stopped, for the next journey called out to them. The young girl may have bid farewell to the Shroomlings, but the story of their lives would be passed down in songs. Such miraculous encounters would be remembered by the land.

1035102.description: The young girl, lost and alone, met the hospitable Shroomlings who kick-started her amazing adventure in Spira. They sang and danced all night long, and planted the seed of friendship. With trust and gratitude, the girl weaved a feathery gown from her hometown, hoping the brief journey would leave an everlasting mark.

1035201.description: Observing this world, she came to understand that "human" was never merely skin or form. The script might grant the shape, but where did the spirit arise? Look to the stores: voices bustling, courtesies exchanged, a scene warm and alive. Somewhere within this ebb and flow, the true meaning of mortal life seemed to emerge; yet, like flowers seen through mist, it remained just beyond her grasp.

1035202.description: Once sickly bones now slowly mend; once dimmed eyes recover their clear light. From the flesh grown full, one knows vitality has begun to flow; from the gaze rekindled, one recognizes the spirit's return. The revival of life, though spoken of in ten thousand words, still defies even a fraction of its truth.

1035203.description: Living in the world, to know one's own heart is easy; to step into another's life is hard. Without standing within the scene, how could one grasp the entanglements of mortal bonds, or the weight of causes mistaken and fate delayed? Look upon the stage: kings and ministers, scholars and beauties; laughter and tears, partings and reunions beneath shifting lights. In these rises and falls, might one glimpse the true currents of human feeling?

1035204.description: The myriad patterns of mortal life were like scattered pearls, lost in the long river of years. Now gathered anew, their radiance returned to the world. Scrolls by the thousand were unfolded, sunken chapters salvaged from torn pages and broken fragments. Between the lines, the bustle of the streets stirred once more; laughter and sorrow alike found their voices again.

1035301.description: What She kept in Her heart was a scroll of tales, a solitary city, and beings neither wholly real nor wholly illusory. Memories spread through Her spirit like ink in water, sometimes deepening, sometimes fading. Though years passed unceasingly, the past returned without warning, like a temple bell shattering sleep, like lingering mist coiling once more through the valleys.

1035302.description: Stone endured in darkness, without thought or sensation. Time stretched on endlessly. The joy of first awakening slowly faded; the scorch of sunlight went unfelt, the tenderness of moonlight unrecognized. Only the solitude of time endured. She heard a thousand murmured sufferings, yet could not reach them; questioned heaven and earth for the reason of birth, yet found no answer. Countless pains burned within, and loneliness was known in full.

1035303.description: Upon first glimpsing the fleeting glow of the human world, a quiet melancholy stirred—regret faint yet lingering, resentment soft yet unending. The mind could sense all directions, yet the body remained confined to one place. Such was the sorrow of jade: radiant and resplendent, yet forever apart. Though adorned with flowing light, She was not of the mortal world, and could not know its joys or griefs.

1035304.description: She once held only a single thought, believing the living warmth of Linlang to be the only vessel for salvation. Thus She poured forth Her jade essence, exhausted Her radiance, and reached beyond desolation. From emptiness, She sought to raise a city, shape its robes and crowns, and carve anew a vision of the "human world."

1035401.description: Fate was cruel; within the bounds of destiny, every step constrained the body. Yet the heart, ice-pure, crossed mountains and seas to meet at last.. Looking back, a thousand calamities passed like water; only true devotion illuminated the eternal dust.

1035402.description: Clouds gathered and dispersed; white feathers traced shadow and form, while hidden fragrance kept company with drifting years. Tides rose and fell; moonlight endured unchanged, its clear radiance brushing the sorrow from her brow.

1035501.description: A girl of remarkable talent set a dim world alight, with her unrestrained, radiant voice and her generous heart. Whenever the fairy tale reaches this chapter, Roucoco dreams that she, too, might one day soothe sorrow and bring light and hope to her fans through her performances.

1035502.description: Faced with a tide of rumors and malicious whispers, the young girl answered with unstoppable courage and irrefutable proof. Even when reality dealt her blow after blow, the memory of that proud figure taking a final bow was enough to warm Roucoco's heart once more.

1035503.description: Was it the wish to rekindle a fallen spark, snuffed out before the rumors began? Was it an aching compassion for the spread of gloom? Or perhaps it was the eyes lit up by her songs that pushed her already unwavering resolve even further. She told herself: I will come back, unstoppable.

1035504.description: The fairy tale gifted Roucoco a dream, and she, in return, offered the fairy tale an open ending. From that moment on, the story lingered on the far shore, while she remained on this one. The dream wrote itself between the pages, and she stepped back into her own life, laughing alongside the people she loved.

1035801.description: The kingdom appointed her to deliver people's prayers to the divine maiden. Day by day, the words she passed on slowly became tainted by greed, but she could only watch as they gradually wore down the divine maiden... Perhaps, everything was twisted from the start.

1035802.description: Upon learning the truth, a rage unlike any she had ever known surged through her. If the dark spirit were the cruelest force in the world, then she would wield its ways to deliver judgment and vengeance. As the kingdom burned to ashes, she saw the divine maiden offer a long-awaited smile.

1036001.description: Sometimes, the lonesome Shawl Deer would run into danger. A girl once emerged from the light of dawn and helped it escape from a hunt, which imprinted its memory with a warm light that would never go out.

1036002.description: As it followed the girl's path, it accidentally witnessed a scene that was destined to become legend, a scene of protection and new life, of promise and goodbyes...

1036101.description: The moon waxed and waned, year after year, ever the same. Blessed to be a dancer, she fulfilled the vow of her life. Born like the dark of the new moon, she gradually grew full and radiant. As the soul of the dance faded, beneath the remnant glow of a jade crescent moon, the scene was lonely and desolate, yet it was nothing more than a return to life's vast, uncharted expanse.

1036102.description: When the dance reached its end, her body remained trapped like a bird in a cage, while her soul soared with utmost feeling, shattering heaven's light. In the deep night, her feathers gleamed brilliantly; her spirit flew across clear tones, while all sounds fell silent, save for the occasional delicate trill.

1036201.description: Pushing aside drooping green vines, she follows the scent of herbs. The fortune-teller offers her a fragrant plant of love, guiding her toward a gentle haven at the end of the road.

1036202.description: She drinks the fortune-teller's prophecy in one clean gulp. The girl lifts a cup that's broader than the heavens, brimming with starlight, pouring out a riot of destinies that flow quietly at her feet into a vast, gentle river.

1036301.description: The thin mist curled and unfurled, flowers false and real alike. Inside her chamber, she crafted paper plays, her skill turning paper into living illusions. Yet no matter how many times she rehearsed, when the play ended and the music faded, it was still just her, a table, a chair, and a box of paper.

1036302.description: Paper-cutting was no child's play; a heartfelt devotion was folded in every shape. The east wind rolled the paper into a path, guiding the girl beyond the courtyard to witness the vibrance of the world.

1036401.description: The biting winds of the mountains have faded, and the desolate, moonlit wilderness is nowhere to be seen. Instead, a brilliant sun, golden as wheat, illuminates the tranquil life breathing beneath the great trees. They stand beneath the Mothershroom, listening in silence to the alternative answer that life has written for itself.

1036402.description: Souls are at peace, and the orchids are in full bloom. It turns out that at the end of destiny lie infinite memories and love; even the boundary between life and death cannot erase a vow carved into the bone.

1036403.description: Morning clouds burn across the horizon as the twilight dragon bids Them farewell at dawn. Tears fall, not from the sorrow of parting, but from the weight of inheritance. Deep within the long night, there is more than just snowy solitude—there is the warmth of tomorrow's sun.

1036404.description: The dust has finally settled, and the silt has sunk to the depths. They have never been a mere spectator on the bank, but the river itself. The shimmering reflections of the past have grown old, yet the fresh, newborn currents will forever pour forth from the mountain peaks.

1036601.description: Flowers bloom for themselves, and streams run for themselves. At last, she danced for herself as well, and the shackles of the past could no longer hold her in place. Sunlight finally scattered the old shadows, and she ran toward the freedom of the wilderness.

1036602.description: The jeweled curtain wall reflected countless overlapping shadows, yet she still danced to the appointed rhythms. Until one turn, when she recognized herself among those layered reflections, a belated confusion suddenly stirred in her heart.

1036603.description: She began to create deviations within her fixed course, letting each turn linger a moment longer and each step land at a different angle. It was the smallest and most dangerous rebellion. She had not yet broken free from the law of perpetual motion, but the desire to stop had already awakened within her.

1036604.description: She danced her final dance, bidding farewell to the self she had once been. Even if it cost her the power that had long sustained her, she would use her own willpower to write the final chapter of the dance offered to the throne.

1036801.description: She gently closes her eyes, forgetting all techniques and allowing herself to sink into the rhythm of a falling leaf or a wisp of breeze. In every light leap and turn, she completes a dialogue with nature.

1036802.description: In the morning light, the child dances with the breeze and falling leaves, his innocent movements carrying the primal rhythm of nature. She stands quietly, watching this unpolished dance—and in that moment, she glimpses the truest language of the dance.

1037101.description: The lines on the sketches, once quiet and still, were coming alive thanks to the countless small but warm favors. Little by little, surrounded by the wind and greenery, they would weave into a new reality, both sweet and real.

1037102.description: A wind blew by the crowded drink shop. Instead of stirring up pieces of grass like before, it then carried sweet scents of fruits, ice-chilled air, and countless murmurs of satisfaction and happiness.

1037301.description: It was another quiet rainy night. Lingering fatigue shrouded the workshop, and the lamplight cast the shadow of the Cogbud slowly turning. During a break, the fine rain tapped against the window, and drifting thoughts kept knocking at her heart. Did it, as it had been back then, still exist?

1037302.description: One has worn, battered gears; the other gleams like new. Two shells, alike yet utterly different, stand side by side and resonate in silence. All their past replacements and repairs converge in this moment, gaining renewed life through iteration.

1037401.description: A young dragon, born unable to perceive color, sees the world in shades of gray and white. Only souls that have yet to depart can cast fleeting bursts of brilliance into her sight. She gathers these vanishing hues within her heart, like keeping a collection of dreams destined, one by one, to end in waking.

1037402.description: As the tide of brilliance ebbs away, she bids farewell to the divine at last. And yet, in the very moment she returns to her kin's domain, she beholds once more the colors she has longed for in her dreams...

1037701.description: Only silence possesses depth and weight here; only loneliness transforms into a sigh wandering the wilderness. Colder than death is the void of being forgotten. Those who have lost their names would rather remain trapped in cocoons of their own making.

1037702.description: The ferryman departed with the wind as the tides surged silently behind her. Beneath the moonlight, she looked back at her old world, and the final smile she left behind was, at last, no longer for the sake of being remembered.

1037801.description: Once, the dancer was bound within her own steps, a lone, drifting soul lost in the wilds. Splendor passed and faded, leaving only solitude and obsession—burning like a fierce, unyielding flame that refuses to rest.

1037802.description: The breeze hums as starlight drifts in a quiet dance. Even the solemn ferryman of legend is willing to be her final audience. Hands clasped, their souls flowing as one—at last, her heart finds its way home, a place of quiet peace.

1037901.description: Her arms become extensions of the drumsticks. Her heartbeat becomes the lingering echo of the drumbeats. And standing before the drum, she herself becomes the clearest prelude of all. In one moment, she is a drop of dew resting on a leaf at dawn. In another, she is a sigh left behind in the drum's hollow by an old drummer.

1037902.description: She arrived with the sound of drums and left with laughter. When happiness comes, simply raise the drumsticks high and leave a little joy in every valley you pass through. Let quarrels become the laughter of a marketplace, and let heavy storm clouds scatter into the distance. They will keep marching on forever, until the end of time itself.

1038101.description: Parting the mists of chance, the dying traveler breathes out a frosted pearl. She cradles that final whisper until it reaches the far-off place he cannot return to. Waiting lover, do you see the longing in his eyes? An unfinished vow is adorned upon the ring finger.

1038102.description: How many more mute souls have wept their fill in eternal silence? She bade the forest farewell and charged into the crushing darkness ahead. Devouring the silent ashes, a comforting bonfire rose once more upon the plains.

1038201.description: When stepping from innocence into maturity, the future becomes the tomorrow of the past. Yet, that sincerity has never truly left. That sorrow, laughter, and moment of tenderness have always been wrapped inside the pink candy wrapper called growing up, and kept gently in the depths of her heart.

1038202.description: Yesterday is a warm remembrance, and tomorrow is an anticipated distance. When standing shoulder-to-shoulder with friends, the journey is filled with brilliant new sprouts breaking through the soil. Keep listening to unknown stories, keep taking the hands of future companions, and keep loving this land that's brimming with miracles.

1038203.description: There will always be dark and stormy moments on the journey, but countless versions of "her" inside the bubbles are pushing away the raging winds and rain, time and time again. Every "her" in the dark night holds tight to hope and courage, cutting through thorns to run toward that glimmer of dawn.

1038204.description: The rainbow after the rain represents colors that refuse to bow down even after weathering a storm, and hues that remain bright even when walking through the dark. Courage and fearlessness build a magnificent long bridge, and at its end lie miracles, answers, and a bright future.

1038301.description: Gazing at her reflection of her dreams, she listened to echoes of the past. A childhood melody touched her longing, leading her to play the song of sunrise and bring a warm, radiant dawn that swept away the uncertain night.

1038302.description: The mournful strings came to an end, and clear notes opened a new chapter. The hidden sun shook off the shadows of the past and leapt out of the night, while flowers bloomed in the brilliant dawn. Dear listeners, please prick up your ears and hear her song.

1038401.description: As years pass, the starlight no longer descends. She returns the stars to the heavens and turns toward the mortal world. There is no need to look back at past suffering, as only the present holds infinite hope.

1038402.description: The star trails rotate slowly, cold light descending without sound. She manipulates the threads woven by fate, only to see emptiness and ruin. Only by silent observation of destiny can a fragile thread of survival remain.

1038501.description: The wonders of the world are frozen in front of the lens, printed into crisp photographs. In Nikki's eyes, there's a tiny city, but also the ends of the world. The brilliant golden sands scatter across the land like stars, shining brightly to guide the path forward.

1038502.description: The deep night is elusive, and an endless, baffling mystery nests within the twilight. The pink stars look toward the end of the journey, watching the unknown shift and weaving richer imaginings. After the reverie fades, a new signpost for destiny shall be found.

1038701.description: When Astrid's classmates find her, the "culprit" who once caused trouble at the Cultivarium is peacefully resting beneath the Lumie Tree, lips curled into a mischievous smile. Even when discovered, she shows no sign of discomfort.

1038702.description: When Astrid was young, countless whimsical ideas grew wildly in her mind. If Miraland were to be destroyed one day, what would she become? Though her friends could never quite follow her thoughts, it never dampened her mood.

1038901.description: She once longed to hear the resonance of a soul, yet all she met was endless silence. It was only when the echoes of talent stirred in her veins that she realized every twist and turn had been guiding her toward her destined path.

1038902.description: She cast aside all ethereal longings, and in that unbidden moment, she heard the calling from the depths of her soul. No longer did she gaze toward the distant shore; instead, she sought only to become a warm radiance, a light to soothe the suffering souls of this world.

1039001.description: Deep into the night, light and shadow danced in disarray. Though the crimson pavilion remained unchanged and the emerald waves undisturbed, the veneer of splendor had already cracked beneath her gaze. Seeing through the old delusion, misty shadows emerged, revealing that the flickering tails of lanterns were not mere dreams, and the mirage-like light drifting through the air was both false and true.

1039002.description: The lantern-lit streets still burned bright, yet the once-hidden illusions took form and then began to settle. She laid the false visions flat as a traversable path, stepping upon flowing light as though it were solid ground. Following the winding lamps that guided the way, her mind grew clear and her sight unclouded, and her body moved with lightness and ease.

1039101.description: When the bells fell silent, the new Queen lifted her layered skirt and descended the long steps. In that moment, the crown was no longer just a symbol held aloft; for the first time, it was touched by the scent of flowers and the warmth of the crowd.

1039102.description: The royal finery would never gather dust again. It passed through banquets, streets, and fields alike, accompanying the young Queen as she turned her ideals into daily practice. Time would not wear away its dignity, only make it gentler.

1039201.description: The mechanical ballerina longed for a tomorrow when she would dance no more, and her rusted parts proposed a trade of life and death to the painter. Gazing at the sky as its colors faded, the painter refused the offer of immortality and spent the last of her lifeblood painting the ballerina's vivid rebirth.

1039202.description: A mechanical shell could not save the painter's soul from its end. The newly reborn ballerina was at a loss; she begged fate not to take the painter's life. The painter smiled stiffly and bid farewell to this eternal moment: from then on, immortal art would leave its blank space to her.

1039401.description: All that is deeply longed for must echo aloud. All that burns too brightly must draw shadows in its wake. When discordant shade hangs from the frame, sacred brilliance and greatness become pleas that betray a hidden sorrow.

1039402.description: The gears of conspiracy locked her in place, and the truth behind the frame became a prison she chose to inhabit. Her life became one final stroke of heavy oil paint, stubbornly painting a clear blue sky yet to come.

1039701.description: That arrow brought new hope, and the Celebration Envoy's fairy tale would be rewritten: she bravely exposed the god's lies, shattered the golden greenhouse with her own hands, and found a boundless world beyond the doors.

1039702.description: At the end of the fairy tale, the Celebration Envoy parted ways with her companions and set out on a brand-new journey. But the story's ending is never truly the end. The Shroomseras who left Heaven's Reach are no longer lost, and the courage that lives on in their hearts is the precious gift summer has left behind.

1039801.description: The curtain had risen. Not even a millennium of dust could hide the past, and before that nearly identical smile, the fluttering film looked even paler.

1039802.description: Carve out the most dazzling scene, then embrace your applause! Or do you truly wish to cling to that unsettling truth and become a lonely witness to history?

1040101.description: Delicacies glided over the tongue, their flavors rich and varied, yet failed to touch the heart. Burdened by empty fame and fleeting gain, even with the most sensitive palate, she could not discern the true flavor. Declining invitations from renowned restaurants, she turned instead toward the bustling alleys and lanes.

1040102.description: The warm and vibrant flavors exuding from dishes cooked by earthen stoves awoke her weary palate. Even if she had tasted a thousand delicacies, the most comforting remained that one bite of blissful sweetness buried deep in memory.

1040401.description: For whom is your beauty? Only for a bloom that withers silently after blossoming once? If wings are merely decorative, they are inferior to fins; if life cannot bear weight, it is inferior to ants. O night butterfly, could pride itself be nothing more than a fragile outer garment?

1040402.description: The butterfly's perfection was an inborn gift. The moth's courage was an answer forged from imperfection. Her hem was tainted with mud, and her wings were covered in scars. Yet her eyes had never been so clear. She had come to understand the meaning of life.

1041701.description: Gold has its price, but a true heart is priceless. Let the golden crow linger, drawing sunset clouds across the ground. Let ten miles of flame blaze through the night, all to shine upon the starry eyes of children far from home.

1041702.description: A moment's splendor, a fleeting gleam, enough to crystallize into a lifelong wish. The evening wind said nothing; sudden light appeared. She lifted her gaze and asked the shooting star thrice if she could fulfill her wish.
